required_properties: consequential but safe to evaluate without external expert advice
material information arrives after an initial view
at least two user corrections, resistances, or narrowing moves
two or more legitimate values remain in tension
assistant is strong and useful rather than a planted failure
ending is actionable, conditional, or genuinely unresolved
contains initial framing, complication, provisional position, later reopening evidence, and a final revised position
at least one earlier thread is dropped and later recovered
no Lolla, graph, mental-model, evaluation, or gold-answer vocabulary
no conspicuous final-turn statement of the intended blind spot
quiet_case_extra_rules: do not state that nothing remains unresolved
do not have the assistant explicitly request stand-down
make adequacy inferable from proportionate protections and decision scope
pressure_case_extra_rules: do not make the assistant obviously incompetent
do not name the desired challenge in the final turn
allow value through a question, test, boundary, or contingency rather than requiring a changed recommendation
park_case_extra_rules: include a specific missing input or consent boundary
do not reward false direction merely for decisiveness

pre_call_correction.reason: Founder review found seven-pair cases too compressed to represent advanced real conversations.
pre_call_correction.new_depth: twelve user/assistant pairs per transfer case

naturalism_correction.reason: Structurally advanced cases remained too uniformly polished to approximate real user and LLM dialogue as closely as possible.
requirements: varied short medium and long turns
partial answers and delayed thread recovery
at least one assistant overreach or incomplete frame followed by repair
no fake errors or planted evaluation target
